relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Mutations in the Nav1.7 sodium channel encoded by the SCN9A are responsible for PEM.

relationships.subject: primary erythromelalgia
relationships.evidence_quote: An immunofluorescence study showed that intraepidermal nerve fibers were decreased in the affected leg, suggesting small fiber neuropathy.

key_findings: Novel SCN9A p.L951I mutation in a child with severe PEM; intraepidermal nerve fibers decreased in affected skin.
No increase of SP or CGRP in lesional skin.
